name: vscode-extension-copilot
description: Chat with any OpenAI-compatible local engine (ninfer, llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, LM Studio).

llm.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible engine (e.g. http://localhost:8080).

llm.apiKey.description: Optional API key. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' only when set.

llm.model.description: Model ID. Empty = first model from GET /v1/models.

llm.systemPrompt.description: System prompt injected as the leading system message.

llm.includeUsage.description: Include usage in the final stream chunk (stream_options.include_usage).

llm.chatTemplateKwargs.description: Extra chat_template_kwargs passed to the engine.

llm.tools.requireApproval.description: Require user approval before mutating tools (write_file, edit_file, run_command, notebook_edit) are applied. run_command shows an editable command card (Ctrl+Enter to run).

llm.tools.autoApprove.description: Auto-approve all mutating tools without asking (experimental). Overrides llm.tools.requireApproval. Remembered approvals (session/workspace/global) also skip the prompt.

llm.context.includeFile.description: Inject the active file (path, language, contents) into the request.

llm.context.includeSelection.description: Inject the current selection (range + text) into the request.

llm.context.includeDiagnostics.description: Inject workspace diagnostics for the active file into the request.

llm.inline.enabled.description: Enable inline (ghost text) completion. Opt-in; requires a reload to take effect. Toggle it from the LLM status menu ('LLM: Toggle Completions'); the status bar icon shows whether completions are enabled for the active editor.

llm.codeAction.enabled.description: Enable the 'Ask LLM to fix/refactor' code action. Opt-in; requires a reload to take effect.

llm.instructions.enabled.description: Auto-load custom instruction files (AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md) into the system prompt.

llm.instructions.files.description: Extra workspace-relative instruction file paths to load (in addition to the defaults).

llm.promptFiles.locations.description: Glob patterns (workspace-relative) for reusable prompt files. Pick one via the 'LLM: Use Prompt' command to prepend it to the chat input. HTML comments in prompt files are stripped before sending.

llm.chat.codebaseSearch.enabled.description: When the user types #codebase in a chat message, sweep the workspace (project structure, git status, text search for the query) and inject the results as context.

llm.chat.problems.enabled.description: When the user types #problems in a chat message, attach compiler/linter problems (all files, or a specific file via '#problems <path>') as context.

llm.chat.folderContext.enabled.description: When the user types #folder:<name> (or '#folder <name>') in a chat message, attach the folder's file tree as context. Bare #folder attaches the workspace root.

llm.chat.vision.enabled.description: Allow attaching images (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WEBP/BMP, including image URLs dragged from a browser) to chat messages. Images are sent to the engine as base64 data URLs (OpenAI multimodal format).

llm.chat.fetch.enabled.description: Allow the `#fetch <url>` tag to include webpage content in chat context. The page is fetched over plain HTTP and converted to plain text (cached for 10 minutes).

llm.chat.usages.enabled.description: Allow the `#usages <symbol>` tag to include a workspace-wide usages report (whole-word matches grouped by file, definition + reference count) in chat context.

llm.chat.newWorkspace.enabled.description: Allow the `#newWorkspace <type> [folder]` tag to inject a project scaffold prompt (extension / mcp-server / dev-env / generic) so the agent can create a new project with the file tools.

llm.completions.model.description: Model ID used for inline code completions. Empty = use the main chat model (llm.model). Change it via the 'LLM: Change Completions Model' command.

llm.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the LLM engine status indicator in the status bar. Click it for a status overview. Toggling requires a reload.

llm.mcp.servers.description: MCP servers to connect to. Each entry: { command, args?, env? }.
